headline: Czech Railways trains are back in fashion; reports record profit and most passengers since COVID
summary: The České dráhy group posted its historically best economic result in the first half of 2026, with pre-tax profit above two billion, and reported its most passengers since COVID.
why: Czech Railways is the state-owned national rail operator, and its financial results reflect public transport demand and state subsidy arrangements.
